stations.title: Ailsa
stations.say: Can the pages fit the new pagers?
stations.note: And the hills are typed three ways.

stations.title: Team pagers
stations.text: Long pages break in the middle of a word.

stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: One line a page. That I can read.

captions: At the radio desk, Ailsa asks for pages that fit the team's new pagers.
Today a long page breaks in the middle of a word, and hill names come in three ways.
You import tools Python already has, and find one by reading its module's page.
Now each page reaches the pagers in clean lines, with the hill people meant.
Rhona gets a one-line summary of every page, and Ailsa's own tools still work.
